name: Plotonium Destructive Edge X: Wings of Solitude
summary: The Plotonium Explosive Smasher universe is back. This time, it comes with an action-focused spin-off. You play as the Dark Angel, a teenage mech pilot that works for the world government, with the mission to defeat the evil organization DROGO (Dragon Resistance Operation for Global Occupation) and demonstrate his capacities. Travel through different areas and reach the best clasifications while defeating your enemies.
